title: exec-staff-briefing-capture
body:
Purpose: quick solo capture ahead of Fri exec staff (30m). Use as cheat-sheet during the walk-through and to seed follow-ups. Not meant for distribution yet — this is my private prep.

Meeting goals (my lens):
- Surface hard asks that need exec sign-off (budget shifts, acceptance criteria for APAC pilot).
- Confirm owners for canary windows and rollback triggers for upcoming Dedicated rollout.
- Identify one prioritized cross-org action with a measurable outcome for next leadership check-in.

Attendees I expect: CEO, CTO (Rohit), Head of Product (Ava), Head of Ops, Head of Sales (Maya), myself.

Agenda bullets I will hit (5–7 min each):
1) Dedicated SLA health and delta to target 
   - Current: p95 latency 180ms (goal 150ms) across text-gen workload on rtx-pool; 2x SLO misses last week (3/5–3/7) tied to autoscaler thrash.
   - Quick cause: autoscaler cooldown + burst inflight queueing. Memory fragmentation suspected on GPU hosts (SRE note).
   - Ask: temporary increase in burst capacity (20%) for next 2 weeks while release of improved allocator lands. Cost estimate: ~$36k/month.
   - Decision needed: yes/no on short-term budget delta + who signs? (Finance prefers SRE/Infra cost owner sign-off).

2) APAC Private pilot readiness (Japan cloud region)
   - Status: infra baseline validated; one remaining compliance doc for customer audit (trace retention config).
   - Open risk: KMS integration work (on-prem HSM vs cloud KMS) — action from security lead with ETA 3/18.
   - Ask: signal from execs to prioritize HSM effort vs shipping with cloud-KMS fallback for first tranche.

3) Redwood Optimize quick wins for Q2 (ops & product alignment)
   - Proposal: run tiered batching experiment on 10 top customers to reduce token cost by ~12–18% (proj. savings $120k/mo).
   - Need: product approval to run customer-impacting config, legal sign-off on A/B changes (no PII exposure).
   - Decision: greenlight pilot? If yes, assign product owner and SRE lead, define rollback criteria.

4) People & org: Exec staffing ask
   - 1x infra hire (senior infra SW, IC4) to unblock allocator release — hiring team requests exec prioritization for slot.
   - Quick note on morale: recent pager load spike created friction in infra-team all-hands; propose 2-hour quiet window for on-call rotations next week.

Key talking points / scripts (short):
- On costs: "This is a short runway trade to stabilize SLOs; we will decommission the extra burst after allocator release and measure cost delta."
- On APAC: "We can ship with cloud-KMS to meet timeline for pilot but need a roadmap and commitment to HSM by end of Q2 for enterprise deals."
- On Optimize: "This is reversible; we will monitor latency and quality regression via the eval suite tied to prompt sets."

Parking lot (bring up only if time)
- Marketplace listing timeline for dedicated (sales ask)
- Long-term model routing policy (sweeping design doc overdue)

Notes-to-self during discussion:
- When CEO asks about SLA misses: call out autoscaler cooldown config & put next steps (infra runbook update + postmortem due 3/20).
- If Finance pushes back on burst cost: propose a 2-week trial with daily cost telemetry visible to CFO.

Action items (captured live):
- (ai-1) Ask Finance for provisional $36k/month burst delta approval for 2 weeks; owner: Jordan (me); due: 2026-03-15.
- (ai-2) Security to confirm HSM integration ETA and blocker list; owner: Ava; due: 2026-03-18.
- (ai-3) Product to approve Optimize pilot (scope + success metrics); owner: Rohit; due: 2026-03-17.
- (ai-4) Infra to prepare rollback runbook and postmortem template; owner: SRE lead (TBD); due: 2026-03-20.

Follow-ups I will send right after meeting (email + Slack):
- Short note to CFO with cost trial ask + links to telemetry dashboard.
- Shared summary to execs with decisions and AIs (1-pager in Confluence).

Tone/risks to manage: be concise, avoid technical deep-dives unless CTO asks. Push for clear owners and dates. If pushback, trade timeline not scope (i.e., we can extend pilot windows instead of cutting features).

Quick links for reference (paste during meeting):
- Allocator PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/482
- Dedicated SLA dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/SLAs/dedicated-pool
- Optimize proposal doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/RED-401/optimize-q2-playbook

End notes: capture decisions immediately in exec meeting doc and slot a 15-min follow-up sync only if multiple AIs unresolved.
